decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly and efficiently as possible using a combination of cards like Archive Trap, Hedron Crab, and Fractured Sanity. The deck also includes disruption cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board while continuing to mill them out. Additionally, cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter provide a win condition by exiling all of the opponent's library once a certain threshold of cards have been milled. The deck is focused on disrupting the opponent's game plan and winning through milling their library.

This aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Scion of Draco, Ragavan, and Territorial Kavu to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to control the board while Lightning Bolt provides direct damage. Counterspell and Force of Negation protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's strategy. Expressive Iteration and Preordain help with card selection and finding the right spells. The deck also includes a few lands that provide access to a variety of colors to ensure you have the mana you need for your spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly with efficient creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It also disrupts the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also has powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to help close out games. With a mix of aggressive creatures, disruption, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main strategy of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful colorless spells like Karn, the Great Creator, and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also includes control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck can quickly ramp up to powerful threats and control the game with its powerful spells.

The deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to quickly and efficiently ramp up mana and trigger lands to create powerful combos. The key strategy involves utilizing land cards like Urza's Saga, Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion, and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage and overwhelm opponents. By combining cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Cultivator Colossus, the deck can effectively search for key pieces and establish dominance on the battlefield. Additionally, the inclusion of Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines adds an extra layer of control and disruption to the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and dismantle the opponent's game plan through hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to control the game by using cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to strip the opponent's resources while gradually building its own advantage. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Sheoldred's Edict and The One Ring further solidifies the deck's ability to dominate the late game and close out matches efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with valuable enter-the-battlefield abilities to create powerful combos and synergies. By using cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, along with creature toolbox cards like Chord of Calling, the deck can generate value and board presence rapidly. The inclusion of mana dorks like Ignoble Hierarch and Wall of Roots, along with land ramp cards like Gilded Goose, allow for quicker access to the deck's powerful combo pieces. Overall, this deck is designed to efficiently assemble and leverage creature-based combos to overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending to quickly bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. It also includes cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to take advantage of powerful combo plays and control elements to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's strategy and provide consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of artifacts like Urza's Saga and Stoneforge Mystic to generate value, disrupt the opponent with cards like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole, and protect its strategy with cards like Esper Sentinel and Pithing Needle. The deck aims to assemble powerful artifact combos like Thopter Foundry/Sword of the Meek and Nettlecyst to overwhelm the opponent and win the game. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler for additional control and card advantage.

The deck relies on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create powerful synergies and combos, allowing for flexibility and adaptability in different situations. By tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can quickly assemble a toolbox of creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Blood Artist can provide additional value through sacrifice outlets and life gain, giving the deck multiple win conditions.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes powerful multicolored creatures such as Territorial Kavu, Nishoba Brawler, and Scion of Draco to deal significant damage to the opponent. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help to control the battlefield and protect your creatures, while Stubborn Denial provides additional protection. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and versatility in your deck construction. With a mix of early aggression and resilient threats, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on disruption and hand control while utilizing efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. With cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, the deck aims to strip away the opponent's resources while cards like Fatal Push and Grief help clear the way for aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Orcish Bowmasters. Using a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a win before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies with a mix of powerful spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The goal is to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, while using cards like Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial to protect them. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all colors needed to cast the diverse spells in the deck, with the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring offering additional utility and mana fixing. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the opponent's graveyard with cards through mill effects like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab, and then utilizing powerful mill spells like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity to rapidly deplete their library. Control elements like Force of Negation and Counterspell help protect the combo pieces, while cards like Extirpate and Surgical Extraction disrupt the opponent's strategy further by removing key cards from their graveyard. The deck aims to win by decking out the opponent and forcing them to draw from an empty library, while maintaining control over the game through counterspells and removal.

The deck focuses on using cards that can manipulate the graveyard and "cycle" through the deck quickly to set up for a powerful combo with Living End. By using cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Shardless Agent, the player can quickly fill their graveyard with creatures before casting Living End to put them all into play at once. This combo can overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures, while also having cards like Force of Negation and Press the Enemy to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to consistently apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient, disruptive creatures and spells while also disrupting their hand and board state with cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Liliana of the Veil. The deck looks to control the game by stripping the opponent's resources and reducing their options, while also presenting a clock with aggressive creatures like Grief and Orcish Bowmasters. The use of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and The Rack helps to clear the way for the deck to close out games quickly.
